title: Technical support
lead: Open a ticket to report problems or ask for help. The team will get a notification and you can track progress from this same section.

docsCard.title: Documentation
docsCard.body: For how to use the app, check the <docsLink>panel documentation</docsLink>.

tips.title: Tips for a good report
tips.expectedVsActual: Describe what you expected and what happened instead.
tips.reproSteps: Concrete steps to reproduce the problem.
tips.environment: Browser, operating system, and whether it is mobile or desktop.
tips.errors: Error message text or what you see in the console (F12).
tips.attachments: You can attach screenshots in JPG or PNG (up to 5 images, 5 MB each).

form.title: Create ticket
form.subject: Subject
form.descriptionPlaceholder: Include steps to reproduce, browser, error messages…
form.attachmentsHint: JPG, JPEG, or PNG. Max 5 files, 5 MB each.

list.title: My tickets
list.empty: You don't have any tickets yet. Use the form above to create one.

detail.closedMessage: This ticket is closed. No more messages can be sent.

alerts.listLoadError: Could not load the ticket list.
alerts.invalidImageType: Only JPG, JPEG, or PNG images are allowed.
alerts.imageTooLarge: Each image must be at most 5 MB.

public.metaDescription: AppMenuQR technical support: sign in with your account to contact the team.
public.title: Technical support
public.body: To contact technical support, sign in with your AppMenuQR account. In the admin panel you will find the support section with contact details and the incident form.
